stem: Which earlier protest was most similar to the one described above?

options.label: F
options.text: The gathering of disillusioned youth at Woodstock

options.label: G
options.text: The burning of draft cards by opponents of the Vietnam War

options.label: H
options.text: The March on Washington for Jobs and Freedom

options.label: J
options.text: The labor demonstrations during the Pullman strike

visual_elements: American Indian leaders and activists organize a nonviolent protest to bring attention to issues affecting American Indians. More than 600 people travel in the “Trail of Broken Treaties” in a caravan of buses, cars, trucks, and campers to Saint Paul, Minnesota.
— “1972: Trail of Broken Treaties,” U.S. National Library of Medicine, Native Voices, www.nlm.nih.gov (accessed April 7, 2014)
